description: Inputs every implementation must reject. `operation` names the call under test; the only correct outcome is an error. An implementation that returns plaintext for any of these is broken, not lenient.

vectors.name: unwrap-wrong-recipient
vectors.description: a wrapped key addressed to another device must not open
vectors.reason: the AEAD key is derived from the recipient's own public key

vectors.name: unwrap-wrong-epoch
vectors.description: SPEC §3.3: a wrapped key replayed at a different epoch must not open
vectors.reason: the epoch is bound into the AAD

vectors.name: unwrap-tampered-ciphertext
vectors.description: one flipped bit in the wrapped group key
vectors.reason: Poly1305 authentication fails

vectors.name: unwrap-tampered-ephemeral-key
vectors.description: one flipped bit in the ephemeral public key
vectors.reason: a different shared secret derives a different AEAD key

vectors.name: unwrap-unknown-version
vectors.description: version byte 0x02
vectors.reason: an unknown container version is rejected before any key material is touched

vectors.name: unwrap-truncated
vectors.description: the last byte of the tag removed
vectors.reason: a wrapped key has exactly one valid length

vectors.name: entry-wrong-epoch
vectors.description: SPEC §3.3: an entry from another epoch must not open, it must be skipped
vectors.reason: the epoch feeds both the HKDF info and the AAD

vectors.name: entry-wrong-entry-id
vectors.description: the same ciphertext presented under another entry id
vectors.reason: entry_id is bound into the AAD, so an entry cannot be relabelled

vectors.name: entry-tampered-ciphertext
vectors.description: one flipped bit in the ciphertext
vectors.reason: Poly1305 authentication fails

vectors.name: entry-tampered-nonce
vectors.description: one flipped bit in the nonce
vectors.reason: the nonce is the HKDF salt, so a different nonce derives a different content key

vectors.name: entry-truncated-tag
vectors.description: the last byte of the tag removed
vectors.reason: a truncated container never authenticates

vectors.name: entry-unknown-version
vectors.description: version byte 0x02
vectors.reason: an unknown container version is rejected before any key material is touched

vectors.name: entry-wrong-group-key
vectors.description: an entry from another group, or from before a rekey the client already applied
vectors.reason: the content key is derived from the group key

vectors.name: frame-trailing-bytes
vectors.description: a well-formed frame with one extra byte appended
vectors.reason: the frame encoding is canonical; trailing bytes are rejected

vectors.name: frame-truncated-body
vectors.description: body_len promises more bytes than the frame carries
vectors.reason: length prefixes are validated against the remaining input

vectors.name: frame-unknown-version
vectors.description: frame version byte 0x02
vectors.reason: an unknown frame version is rejected

vectors.name: frame-pad-len-nonzero
vectors.description: pad_len is reserved and MUST be zero in v1
vectors.reason: padding is specified but not implemented (SPEC §9); a non-zero pad_len is a future format

vectors.name: frame-empty-content-type
vectors.description: a zero-length content type
vectors.reason: content_type is mandatory

vectors.name: header-wrong-entry-id
vectors.description: a header moved onto another entry must not open
vectors.reason: the entry id is bound into the AAD

vectors.name: header-wrong-epoch
vectors.description: a header presented at another epoch must not open
vectors.reason: the epoch is in the key derivation and the AAD

vectors.name: header-tampered-ciphertext
vectors.description: one flipped bit in the header ciphertext
vectors.reason: Poly1305 authentication fails

vectors.name: header-unknown-version
vectors.description: a container version this profile does not implement
vectors.reason: rejected before any key is derived

vectors.name: header-wrong-length
vectors.description: a container that is neither 297 nor 553 bytes
vectors.reason: every header of a version is the same size

vectors.name: header-decode-unknown-version
vectors.description: an encoded header of an unknown version
vectors.reason: the version byte is checked first

vectors.name: header-decode-pad-nonzero
vectors.description: a non-zero byte in the padding
vectors.reason: the encoding is canonical

vectors.name: header-decode-empty-content-type
vectors.description: an empty content type
vectors.reason: a header always names a type

vectors.name: header-decode-length-overflow
vectors.description: a length prefix past the end of the header
vectors.reason: lengths must fit

vectors.name: header-decode-wrong-size
vectors.description: an encoded header that is not 256 bytes
vectors.reason: every header is the same size

vectors.name: header-decode-v2-at-v1-size
vectors.description: a v2 version byte on a 256-byte header
vectors.reason: each version has exactly one size

vectors.name: header-v2-decode-v1-at-v2-size
vectors.description: a v1 version byte on a 512-byte header
vectors.reason: each version has exactly one size

vectors.name: header-v2-decode-pad-nonzero
vectors.description: a non-zero byte in a v2 header's padding
vectors.reason: the encoding is canonical

vectors.name: header-v2-decode-filename-too-long
vectors.description: a v2 filename of 256 bytes
vectors.reason: a v2 writer cuts filenames to 255 bytes

vectors.name: header-v2-decode-wrong-size
vectors.description: a v2 header that is not 512 bytes
vectors.reason: every header of a version is the same size

vectors.name: store-link-wrong-epoch
vectors.description: a link presented as joining epochs 2 and 3 instead of 1 and 2
vectors.reason: both epochs are in the key derivation and the AAD

vectors.name: store-link-wrong-key
vectors.description: a link opened with the previous epoch's store key
vectors.reason: links only lead from a newer key to an older one

vectors.name: store-link-tampered
vectors.description: one flipped bit in a link's ciphertext
vectors.reason: Poly1305 authentication fails

vectors.name: store-link-unknown-version
vectors.description: a link version this profile does not implement
vectors.reason: rejected before any key is derived

vectors.name: store-link-wrong-length
vectors.description: a link that is not exactly 49 bytes
vectors.reason: every link is the same size

vectors.name: store-link-epoch-1
vectors.description: a link into epoch 1, which has no earlier epoch
vectors.reason: the first epoch of a group has no link

vectors.name: store-wrap-wrong-item-id
vectors.description: item keys moved onto another item
vectors.reason: the item id is bound into the AAD

vectors.name: store-wrap-wrong-epoch
vectors.description: item keys presented as wrapped at another epoch
vectors.reason: the epoch is in the key derivation and the AAD

vectors.name: store-wrap-wrong-store-key
vectors.description: item keys opened with another epoch's store key
vectors.reason: a reader walks the chain to the epoch the item was wrapped at

vectors.name: store-wrap-tampered
vectors.description: one flipped bit in the wrapped keys
vectors.reason: Poly1305 authentication fails

vectors.name: store-wrap-unknown-version
vectors.description: a wrap version this profile does not implement
vectors.reason: rejected before any key is derived

vectors.name: store-wrap-wrong-length
vectors.description: wrapped keys that are not exactly 105 bytes
vectors.reason: every wrap is the same size

vectors.name: store-container-wrong-item-id
vectors.description: a store blob opened as another item
vectors.reason: the item id is the entry id bound into the AAD

vectors.name: store-container-wrong-epoch
vectors.description: a store blob opened at another content epoch
vectors.reason: the content epoch is bound into the AAD

vectors.name: store-meta-wrong-item-id
vectors.description: a metadata record moved onto another item
vectors.reason: the item id is bound into the AAD

vectors.name: store-meta-wrong-rev
vectors.description: a metadata record replayed as a later revision
vectors.reason: the revision is bound into the AAD

vectors.name: store-meta-tampered
vectors.description: one flipped bit in a sealed record
vectors.reason: Poly1305 authentication fails

vectors.name: store-meta-unknown-version
vectors.description: a sealed record version this profile does not implement
vectors.reason: rejected before any key is derived

vectors.name: store-meta-wrong-length
vectors.description: a sealed record that is not exactly 2089 bytes
vectors.reason: every record is the same size

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-unknown-version
vectors.description: a record version this profile does not implement
vectors.reason: the version byte is checked first

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-wrong-size
vectors.description: a record that is not 2048 bytes
vectors.reason: every record is the same size

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-pad-nonzero
vectors.description: a non-zero byte in the padding
vectors.reason: the encoding is canonical

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-length-overflow
vectors.description: a length prefix past the end of the record
vectors.reason: lengths must fit

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-empty-name
vectors.description: an item with no name
vectors.reason: every item has a name

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-empty-content-type
vectors.description: an empty content type
vectors.reason: a record always names a type

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-empty-tag
vectors.description: a zero-length tag
vectors.reason: a tag is never empty

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-duplicate-tag
vectors.description: the same tag twice
vectors.reason: tags are a set; a writer never repeats one

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-too-many-tags
vectors.description: 17 tags
vectors.reason: an item has at most 16 tags

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-name-too-long
vectors.description: a 201-byte name
vectors.reason: a name is at most 200 bytes

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-description-too-long
vectors.description: an 801-byte description
vectors.reason: a description is at most 800 bytes

vectors.name: store-meta-decode-tag-too-long
vectors.description: a 33-byte tag
vectors.reason: a tag is at most 32 bytes
